exatos.Produto, índice, janela de 12 meses, mín: Product, index, 12-month window, minimum of 6 valid composites and quality rule are an operational assumption of the prototype (D-007, issue #69), not a validated parameter. See 'parametros'.
exatos.risco_zarc_pct é o risco oficial da port: risco_zarc_pct is the official risk from the ZARC ordinance; risco_historico_falha_severa is the frequency simulated by TELLUS; margem_r_ha is economic. They are different measures.

exatos.Aplicação da regra do produto: rank 0 (': Product rule applied: rank 0 ('Good Data — use with confidence') becomes a value; rank 1 ('Marginal data — useful, but look at other QA information') becomes a value only if VI Quality says 'VI produced' (bits 0–1 = 00 or 01) and does not flag adjacent cloud (bit 8), mixed clouds (bit 10), possible snow/ice (bit 14) or possible shadow (bit 15); rank 2 (snow/ice), 3 (cloud) and −1 (no data) become gaps. The choice of bits checked for rank 1 is a prototype assumption.
exatos.Fração (por peso de área) de pixels váli: Fraction (by area weight) of valid pixels required for a composite to become the area value. 1.0 = any invalid pixel makes the whole area a gap; nothing is filled in.
exatos.Hipótese operacional do protótipo: MODIS: Operational assumption of the prototype: MODIS/Terra MOD13Q1 v061. MYD13Q1 (Aqua) is supported but off by default.
Operational assumption of the prototype: NDVI. The request can switch to EVI.
exatos.Hipótese operacional: série inicial dos: Operational assumption: initial series of the last 12 months, counted from the latest composite available in the cache (not from the clock), so the same cache gives the same response. inicio/fim in the request replace the window.
exatos.Mínimo provisório: com menos de 6 compos: Provisional minimum: with fewer than 6 valid composites in the window, the series is declared 'insufficient'. Nothing is filled in.
exatos.Nuvem (bit 1), adjacente a nuvem/sombra: Cloud (bit 1), adjacent to cloud/shadow (bit 2), shadow (bit 3) and snow/ice (bit 4) become gaps. Bit 0 (cirrus) is reserved and not used in v2.0. A band with fill value (−9999) is always a gap.
